planets.name: TOI-1064 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1064 with a 6.44-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: TOI-1064 b was found in 2022 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-1064. Its orbit and size follow Wilson et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
